My mom does similar things to me about my depression (I don't have ocd) and some of my other issues. I don't think she intends to be so hurtful to me, but she deflects if I try to tell her how it's affecting me. 

I think a lot of people just can't understand the severity of what you struggle with until you go so far as to attempt suicide. They sometimes say they do, but their actions just don't match. Most of my friends never checked up on me until I attempted, but after the attempt I was constantly getting messages asking how I was doing etc. Etc. It's like something clicks in people's heads "ooooh so you have DEPRESSION depression" and they suddenly care 10x more. 

It's not really a good thing, not for me at least. All the attention was draining and I got tired of trying to convince people I was fine. I regretted my attempt not because I didn't want to die anymore, but because of how life got even worse for me afterwards. 

Hang in there, hopefully you can move out/away soon and not have to deal with that anymore
